card.name: Jim Crow era racial segregation history
card.fires_on: Linking words and nouns in passages about the history of racial segregation and discrimination against Black Americans, right where a word like segregation, discrimination or Jim Crow is likely to come next.

modes.label: Linking word before segregation terms
modes.description: Words like of, to or were that sit just before a term such as racial segregation or discrimination.

modes.label: Inside civil rights history phrases
modes.description: Words within period phrases such as separate but equal, segregated theaters, or lunch counter sit-ins.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about segregation, discrimination and racism, and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires in texts on Jim Crow and civil rights history, just before words about segregation or discrimination.
